newsitem.title: SPAIN: UN may approve Zaire force in 24-48 hours, Spain says.
newsitem.headline: UN may approve Zaire force in 24-48 hours, Spain says.

text.p: The United Nations may give a green light to the deployment of a multinational force in Zaire within 48 hours, Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes told state radio on Tuesday.

Matutes was quoted by state radio as saying he was optimistic for the first time since the crisis in Zaire began because the United Nations could approve the intervention of a multinational force in 24 to 48 hours, the radio report said.
Spain said on Monday it had put troops on alert for an immediate deployment of a multinational force, should the U.N. approve it.

Spain is prepared to send 300 elite soldiers in an initial force and will consider whether to send more in later phases of the operation. The troops would secure humanitarian corridors to facilitate distribution of aid to more than a million refugees.
A Defense Ministry spokesman said on Monday the U.N. may approve a multinational rapid-deployment force in which Spain and France would participate initially.
